scope: All four Java/Kotlin JVM cases. Android cases remain in whole-change file measurements because their changes also span new declarations, resources and multiple runtime entrypoints. This is a declared granular comparison, not a replacement for full-change coverage.
selectionTiming: Production patch and pristine declaration IDs inspected before these member impact queries and production-only/original-test replays. No original failing-test target is used to choose seeds. Selectors remain evaluator-only.
